note: Nationally-representative / administrative counterweights to the Reuters DNR online-English slice. Three independent sources: TRAI (administrative telecom supply), IAMAI-Kantar ICUBE (face-to-face internet-use survey, ~90k households), and MoSPI NSS CMS:T 2025 (official household survey). Figures transcribed/verified from primary PDFs.

trai.vintage: Yearly Performance Indicator Report 2024-25 (year ending Mar 2025); plus QE Dec-2025 quarterly where noted.

data_usage_latest.note: Quarterly Performance Indicator Report, quarter ending Dec 2025.

iamai.vintage: IAMAI-Kantar ICUBE 'Internet in India 2024' (rel. Jan 2025); 2025 from press release.

aiu_split_2024.label: Active internet users by area, 2024 (rural overtook urban)

news_users_2024.label: Online news users among India's 886M active internet users, 2024
news_users_2024.note: Online News Users = encounter news online (via apps, social, forwards, YouTube) consciously or unconsciously. Conscious Online News Users = deliberately seek news. '3 of 5 internet users encounter news online, but only 1 in 5 consciously read it.'

rows.category: Conscious online news users (seek it out)

mospi_cmst_2025.vintage: NSS Comprehensive Modular Survey: Telecom 2025 (CMS:T, fieldwork Jan-Mar 2025). Nationally representative.

internet_use_by_gender_pct.label: Persons aged 15+ able to use the internet, 2025 (the digital divide)
